title: Kirak models.json
description: All models of a Kirak project, by model name. A project either has one models.json or a models/ directory with one file per model (each validated by model.schema.json).

propertyNames.description: Model names are plain SQL identifiers: letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit.

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema. Kirak ignores it when loading.
